LESSON: WRITING 5.4.1 CREATIVE WRITING: NARRATIVE COMPOSITIONS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.4: Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Compositions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Compositions, part of Strand 5 in Grade 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why do you enjoy reading stories? 2. How do you make your composition interesting?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm ideas for a narrative composition collaboratively with peers,

2. read samples of narrative compositions with peers,

3. identify the parts of a narrative composition,

4. compose a narrative of 120 -160 words individually or collaboratively,

5. practise writing own narratives,

6. listen or view a recording of a narrative and rewrite it in own words,

7. proofread each other’s work and give feedback. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm ideas for a narrative composition collaboratively with peers,
2. read samples of narrative compositions with peers,
3. identify the parts of a narrative composition,
4. compose a narrative of 120 -160 words individually or collaboratively,
5. practise writing own narratives,
6. listen or view a recording of a narrative and rewrite it in own words,
7. proofread each other’s work and give feedback. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Compositions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and Imagination is enhanced as the learner creates and writes stories.

• Learning to learn is developed as the learner listens or view a recording of a narrative and re-write it in own words,

Patriotism is developed as learners create narrative compositions featuring traditional foods for different communities

showing respect for each other.
